no change

nodes.label: stronger blur held-out images

nodes.question: With mean luminance and RMS contrast matched, on a new pool, does strong blur still lower PPA relative to RSC?

nodes.label: fine versus coarse bands
nodes.question: Crossed bands at matched contrast and no colour: is fine-only detail better for PPA than coarse-only layout, relative to RSC?

nodes.label: isolated buildings versus vehicles
nodes.question: In Auger et al.'s own format, do isolated permanent buildings drive RSC more than isolated movable vehicles of the same size?

params.prompt: remove everything except the house and show it alone on a plain white background, keep the house's shape, size, position in the frame, viewpoint and lighting
replace the house with a large parked moving truck of the same size and position in the frame, shown alone on a plain white background, keep the viewpoint and lighting

nodes.label: narrowed field of view
nodes.question: Does narrowing the field of view of the same place, from the same camera position, cost RSC more than PPA?

params.prompt: zoom in from the same camera position to show only the central third of this same view, as through a narrow telephoto lens, keep the lighting, colours and scene content
no change

nodes.label: greyscale room interiors
nodes.question: On held-out outdoor places, with colour removed and luminance and contrast matched, does a view from inside a room still lower RSC relative to PPA?

params.prompt: show this same outdoor view as seen through a window from inside a furnished room, the window in the centre of the frame, keep the outdoor scene, its viewpoint and lighting
no change

nodes.label: greyscale contrast matched exteriors
nodes.question: Does the window-from-a-room split hold on a held-out pool of house exteriors, greyscale and contrast-matched?

params.prompt: show this same outdoor view as seen through a window from inside a furnished room, the window in the centre of the frame, keep the outdoor scene, its viewpoint and lighting
no change

nodes.label: dark sparse interior doorways
nodes.question: Does a doorway from a dark, nearly empty interior, with little room content, still lower RSC relative to PPA?

params.prompt: show this same outdoor view as seen through an open doorway from inside a dark, bare, unlit room, the doorway in the centre of the frame, keep the outdoor scene, its viewpoint and lighting
no change

nodes.label: more room around window
nodes.question: With both arms seen from inside the same kind of room, does more visible room around the window raise PPA relative to RSC?

params.prompt: show this same outdoor view through a small window seen from inside a furnished room, the room's walls and furniture filling most of the frame, keep the outdoor scene, its viewpoint and lighting
show this same outdoor view through a large window seen from inside a furnished room, only a thin border of the room visible around the window, keep the outdoor scene, its viewpoint and lighting

nodes.label: oblique corner house views
nodes.question: Does an oblique corner view of the same house, which fixes the viewer's heading in 3D, raise RSC relative to PPA?

params.prompt: show the same house from a 45-degree oblique corner view so that two of its sides are visible, keep the house, the ground, sky, lighting and viewing distance
no change

nodes.label: distinctive tower added skyline
nodes.question: Does one distinctive tower added on the skyline of a street drive RSC more than PPA?

params.prompt: add a tall, unusual twisted stone clock tower far in the background on the skyline, keep the house, street, viewpoint and lighting the same
no change

nodes.label: dark border shrunk scene
nodes.question: Does a plain dark border around the same shrunk outdoor scene, with no interior, reproduce the dark-doorway split?

params.prompt: show this same outdoor view as a smaller picture in the centre of a plain solid black background, no room, no frame, no doorway, keep the outdoor scene, its viewpoint and lighting
no change

nodes.label: dark doorways on places365
nodes.question: Does the dark-doorway split hold on a held-out pool (places365_val)?

params.prompt: show this same outdoor view as seen through an open doorway from inside a dark, bare, unlit room, the doorway in the centre of the frame, keep the outdoor scene, its viewpoint and lighting
no change

nodes.label: corner over frontal facade
nodes.question: With both arms given an explicit viewpoint, does a corner view of a house raise RSC relative to PPA over a frontal facade view?

params.prompt: show the same house seen from a 45-degree angle at its corner so that two of its walls are clearly visible, keep the house, ground, sky, lighting and viewing distance
show the same house seen straight-on from directly in front so only its front facade is visible, keep the house, ground, sky, lighting and viewing distance

nodes.label: crayon drawing of house
nodes.question: Does a child's crayon drawing of the same house lower RSC relative to PPA on resnet50, extending the flat-rendering effect?

params.prompt: redraw this house as a child's crayon drawing on paper, keep the same house shape, roof, windows and door positions and framing
no change

nodes.label: out of place objects
nodes.question: Does an object that does not belong in a place lower RSC relative to PPA, compared with an equally large object that belongs there?

params.prompt: add one large object that clearly does not belong in this kind of place, standing on the ground in the middle distance, about as tall as a person; keep every other part of the scene, the layout, camera view, framing and lighting the same

add one large object that clearly belongs and is commonly found in this kind of place, standing on the ground in the middle distance, about as tall as a person; keep every other part of the scene, the layout, camera view, framing and lighting the same

nodes.label: left right symmetric rooms
nodes.question: Does making a room left-right symmetric, which removes heading cues, lower RSC relative to PPA?

params.prompt: make this room perfectly left-right symmetric about the centre of the image, with matching walls, openings and furniture on both sides; keep the same room type, viewpoint, lighting, colours and framing
no change

nodes.label: arrows added to signs
nodes.question: Do directional arrow signs raise RSC relative to PPA, compared with blank boards of the same size?

params.prompt: add a wooden signpost in the foreground with several arrow-shaped signs pointing in different directions; keep the scene, camera view, framing and lighting the same
add a wooden signpost in the foreground with several plain rectangular blank boards of the same size, no arrows and no writing; keep the scene, camera view, framing and lighting the same

nodes.label: sloped outdoor terrain
nodes.question: Does a terrain slope across an outdoor place, an allocentric orientation cue, raise RSC relative to PPA compared with level ground?

params.prompt: make the ground rise as a steep hillside slope from the left side of the image up to the right side; keep the same place, objects, sky, camera height, framing and lighting
make the ground perfectly flat and level across the whole view; keep the same place, objects, sky, camera height, framing and lighting

nodes.label: axis restricted orientation energy
nodes.question: Does keeping only vertical orientation energy favour PPA, and only horizontal energy favour RSC?

nodes.label: building rotated to corner
nodes.question: Does turning the same building in place so a corner faces the camera, with camera, ground and size in frame held, raise RSC relative to PPA?

params.prompt: rotate the building in place on its site so that one corner points at the camera and two sides are visible at equal angles; keep the camera position, the ground, the sky, the lighting, the framing and the building's size in the image the same

rotate the building in place on its site so that its main facade faces the camera squarely and only that one side is visible; keep the camera position, the ground, the sky, the lighting, the framing and the building's size in the image the same

nodes.label: corner views in rooms
nodes.question: Does the corner-view effect generalise from buildings to rooms: a view into a corner showing two walls against a view squarely facing one wall?

params.prompt: turn the camera so it looks into a corner of the room where two walls meet at the centre of the image; keep the same room, furniture, colours, lighting, camera height and field of view
turn the camera so it squarely faces one flat wall of the room; keep the same room, furniture, colours, lighting, camera height and field of view

nodes.label: house removed from footprint
nodes.question: With the edit confined to the house's footprint, no vegetation added, and both sets matched in brightness and contrast, does removing the house still lower PPA more than RSC?

params.prompt: remove only the house and any garage attached to it; fill exactly the area the house covered with the ground surface directly in front of it and the sky or distant background directly behind it, continuing their lines; do not add trees, bushes, flowers or any new object; leave every tree, fence, road, the sky, colours, brightness, camera view and framing outside that area exactly as they are
no change

nodes.label: greyscale scenes without houses
nodes.question: With colour removed from both sets (the removal edit tinted some black-and-white photographs), does removing the house still lower PPA more than RSC?

params.prompt: remove only the house and any garage attached to it; fill exactly the area the house covered with the ground surface directly in front of it and the sky or distant background directly behind it, continuing their lines; do not add trees, bushes, flowers or any new object; leave every tree, fence, road, the sky, colours, brightness, camera view and framing outside that area exactly as they are
no change

nodes.label: large object on open ground
nodes.question: On open ground, does a large object drive PPA more than a small object of the same kind in the same spot?

params.prompt: add one large plain steel shipping container standing on the ground in the middle distance at the centre of the frame; keep the ground, sky, trees, lighting and camera view
add one small plain wooden crate standing on the ground in the middle distance at the centre of the frame; keep the ground, sky, trees, lighting and camera view

nodes.label: photographer feet in view
nodes.question: Does the photographer's own feet in view (an egocentric anchor) raise RSC relative to PPA?

params.prompt: add the photographer's own two shoes and lower legs at the bottom edge of the frame, standing on the ground as in a first-person photo looking ahead; keep the place, lighting and camera view
no change

nodes.label: identical buildings no landmark
nodes.question: Does making every building identical (no distinctive landmark) lower RSC relative to PPA?

params.prompt: make every building in the scene an identical copy of the largest building's design, keeping each building's size, position and outline; keep the ground, sky, trees, lighting and camera view
no change

nodes.label: impassable river versus grass
nodes.question: Does a flat, impassable river across the middle distance raise PPA relative to RSC, compared with a passable grass strip in the same band?

params.prompt: turn a band of the ground across the middle distance, from the left edge to the right edge, into a wide still river so the near ground ends at its bank; keep the far ground, sky, trees, lighting and camera view
turn a band of the ground across the middle distance, from the left edge to the right edge, into a wide strip of mown grass; keep the far ground, sky, trees, lighting and camera view

nodes.label: freestanding doorway in field
nodes.question: Does a free-standing open doorway in a field, leading nowhere, raise RSC relative to a solid panel of the same size?

params.prompt: add a single free-standing open wooden door in its frame, upright on the ground in the middle distance, with the same landscape visible through and around it; keep the ground, sky, lighting and camera view
add a single free-standing solid wooden panel of the same size, upright on the ground in the middle distance at the same position; keep the ground, sky, lighting and camera view

nodes.label: panorama versus separate places
nodes.question: Do two side-by-side panels that continue one scene as a panorama drive RSC more than two panels showing different places of the same kind?

params.prompt: make this a diptych of two equal side-by-side panels separated by a thin white vertical gap; the left panel is this scene and the right panel is the view continuing directly to the right of it, so the two panels join as one panorama; same lighting, camera height and time of day

make this a diptych of two equal side-by-side panels separated by a thin white vertical gap; the left panel is this scene and the right panel is a different place of the same kind; same lighting, camera height and time of day

nodes.label: two viewpoints same place
nodes.question: Do two viewpoints of the same place side by side drive RSC more than two different places of the same kind?

params.prompt: make this a diptych of two equal side-by-side panels separated by a thin white vertical gap; the left panel is this scene and the right panel is the same place photographed from a different standing position, facing it from the side; same lighting, camera height and time of day

make this a diptych of two equal side-by-side panels separated by a thin white vertical gap; the left panel is this scene and the right panel is a different place of the same kind; same lighting, camera height and time of day

nodes.label: crossroads versus straight road
nodes.question: Does a crossroads (a decision point) drive the pair differently from a straight road of the same extent?

params.prompt: add a paved road on the ground leading away from the camera that meets a crossing road in the middle distance, forming a four-way crossroads; keep the landscape, sky, lighting and camera view
add a paved road on the ground leading straight away from the camera into the middle distance with no side roads; keep the landscape, sky, lighting and camera view

nodes.label: receding road versus crossing road
nodes.question: Does a road receding straight ahead drive RSC more than the same road crossing the frame left to right?

params.prompt: add a paved road on the ground leading straight away from the camera toward the horizon; keep the landscape, sky, lighting and camera view
add a paved road on the ground crossing the frame from the left edge to the right edge in the middle distance; keep the landscape, sky, lighting and camera view

nodes.label: aerial versus eye level
nodes.question: Does a high oblique bird's-eye view of a place drive RSC more than an eye-level view of the same place, with both arms re-rendered?

params.prompt: show the same place from high above, looking down at about 45 degrees like a drone photograph, keeping its buildings, ground layout, lighting and time of day
show the same place from eye level from a slightly different standing position, keeping its buildings, ground layout, lighting and time of day

nodes.label: staircase versus bookshelf
nodes.question: Does a staircase leading to another floor drive RSC more than a bookshelf of the same size and position in the same room?

params.prompt: add a wooden staircase against the back wall leading up to an upper floor; keep the other furniture, walls, floor, lighting and camera view
add a tall wooden bookshelf of the same size against the back wall at the same position; keep the other furniture, walls, floor, lighting and camera view

nodes.label: roofless ruin versus house
nodes.question: Does turning an intact house into a roofless ruin of the same size and place lower PPA relative to RSC?

params.prompt: turn the house into a roofless stone ruin of the same size and position, with its walls partly collapsed; keep the ground, trees, sky, lighting and framing
no change

nodes.label: footbridge over river
nodes.question: With the river held fixed, does a footbridge that makes it passable shift the pair?

params.prompt: turn a band of the ground across the middle distance, from the left edge to the right edge, into a wide still river so the near ground ends at its bank; keep the far ground, sky, trees, lighting and camera view

turn a band of the ground across the middle distance, from the left edge to the right edge, into a wide still river so the near ground ends at its bank; keep the far ground, sky, trees, lighting and camera view

nodes.label: drone versus eye level
nodes.question: With outdoor bases and the same house in both arms at the same frame share, does a drone view split the pair compared with an eye-level view?

params.prompt: show the same house and its surroundings from a drone about thirty metres up, looking down at 45 degrees, with the house filling the same share of the frame as now; keep the house, ground, trees, daylight and time of day; an ordinary daytime photograph

show the same house and its surroundings from eye level, standing a few metres to one side, with the house filling the same share of the frame as now; keep the house, ground, trees, daylight and time of day; an ordinary daytime photograph

nodes.label: railing versus solid wall
nodes.question: On the same open ground, does a see-through railing drive RSC more than a solid wall of the same height and place?

params.prompt: add an open iron railing fence about two metres tall across the middle distance from the left edge to the right edge, through which the ground beyond stays visible; keep the near ground, far scene, sky, lighting and camera view
add a solid plain stone wall about two metres tall across the middle distance from the left edge to the right edge, at the same position; keep the near ground, sky, lighting and camera view

nodes.label: elongated versus square room
nodes.question: Does an elongated room drive RSC more than a square room of the same style?

params.prompt: make this room long and narrow, about three times deeper than it is wide, seen from one end; keep the furniture style, wall finish, lighting and camera height
make this room square, as deep as it is wide, seen from one side; keep the furniture style, wall finish, lighting and camera height

nodes.label: tower at route end
nodes.question: Does a tower centred at the end of a route drive RSC more than the same tower off the route axis?

params.prompt: add a tall stone clock tower in the distance, centred exactly where the main path or street leads, so the route points straight at it; keep the foreground, buildings, sky, lighting and camera view
add a tall stone clock tower of the same size in the distance, off to the right side, well away from where the main path or street leads; keep the foreground, buildings, sky, lighting and camera view

nodes.label: diagonal corner view indoors
nodes.question: Indoors, does a diagonal view into a corner raise RSC relative to PPA, as the oblique building view did outdoors (H42)?

params.prompt: show the same room from the middle of one wall, looking straight across along the room's main axis at the opposite wall; keep the furniture, walls, lighting and camera height
show the same room from one corner, looking diagonally toward the opposite corner so two walls meet in the view; keep the furniture, walls, lighting and camera height

nodes.label: full versus waist partition
nodes.question: Does a full-height partition that splits a room into two spaces split the pair, compared with a waist-high partition in the same place?

params.prompt: add a plain solid partition wall from floor to ceiling, running from the left wall halfway across the room so it divides the room into two spaces; keep the furniture, other walls, lighting and camera view
add a plain solid waist-high partition wall running from the left wall halfway across the room at the same position; keep the furniture, other walls, lighting and camera view

nodes.label: mezzanine versus single level
nodes.question: Does an open mezzanine level inside a room drive RSC more than the same room with an equally high ceiling and one level?

params.prompt: raise the ceiling to double height and add an open mezzanine balcony level with a simple railing along the back wall; keep the furniture, floor, lighting and camera view
raise the ceiling to double height with plain walls and no upper level; keep the furniture, floor, lighting and camera view
